spec.experiment: SG29 NERVE-inspired semantic weighting and stopped walk
spec.constant_provenance: alpha/beta and length 10 from released ovs/pipeline_low_rank_eff_final.py; entropy concentration 3 and self weight .01 from released ovs/pipeline_clean_mean_final_run_correct.py. The scripts differ (including L=30 in the latter); this locked hybrid is an adaptation, not an exact NERVE reproduction.
spec.local_transform: (cosine+1)/2+1e-6 on valid 8-neighbors; add 0.01 self transition; row normalize
spec.head_entropy: single-class spatial entropy of one-step semantic output, divided by log(4096); softmax(-3H) within each call
spec.global: historical SD1.5 scaled-dot-product softmax self attention (not NERVE cosine affinity)
spec.ca: historical selected-module A3 class-word seed unchanged, including known orientation caveat
spec.sa: module15 64x64, calls 10-20 inclusive, 8 heads, observation-wise propagation
spec.selection: five fixed VOC folds; raw and R2 selectors separately; registered 0.005/0.010 gain and 4/5 vote rule; COCO transfer only
spec.storage: per-image counts and reduced diagnostics only; no generated images, masks, attention or Q/K retained
